hooks.command: p=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "--- Notification $(date '+%F %T') ---" "$p" >> ~/.claude/hooks.log; msg=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.message // "Claude Code needs attention"' | tr -d '"' | cut -c1-200); afplay -v 3 /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff >/dev/null 2>&1 & osascript -e "display notification \"$msg\" with title \"Claude Code\"" 2>/dev/null || true

p=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "--- Stop $(date '+%F %T') ---" "$p" >> ~/.claude/hooks.log; msg=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // "Task done"' | tr -d '"' | cut -c1-200); afplay -v 3 /System/Library/Sounds/Hero.aiff >/dev/null 2>&1 & osascript -e "display notification \"$msg\" with title \"Claude Code · Done\"" 2>/dev/null || true

p=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "--- SubagentStop $(date '+%F %T') ---" "$p" >> ~/.claude/hooks.log; msg=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // "Subagent done"' | tr -d '"' | cut -c1-200); afplay -v 3 /System/Library/Sounds/Submarine.aiff >/dev/null 2>&1 & osascript -e "display notification \"$msg\" with title \"Claude Code · Subagent\"" 2>/dev/null || true

p=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "--- TeammateIdle $(date '+%F %T') ---" "$p" >> ~/.claude/hooks.log; name=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.teammate_name // .name // .from // "teammate"' | tr -d '"' | cut -c1-40); msg=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // .message // "idle"' | tr -d '"' | cut -c1-180); afplay -v 3 /System/Library/Sounds/Submarine.aiff >/dev/null 2>&1 & osascript -e "display notification \"$msg\" with title \"Claude Code Team · @$name\"" 2>/dev/null || true
